title: Korn Ferry Expands Partnership with Workday to Help Companies Make Talent Decisions that Drive Performance
summary: Korn Ferry’s Workday Marketplace Apps bring proprietary talent intelligence directly into Workday, giving Workday customers deeper insight around roles, skills and workforce planning.
body_markdown:
**Los Angeles, October 8, 2026** - Korn Ferry (NYSE: KFY) today announced that it is expanding its partnership with Workday to help organizations better understand their current talent and skills, identify gaps and plan for future workforce needs.


Performance starts with people — their roles, skills and the decisions that shape how work gets done.[Korn Ferry Assess](https://marketplace.workday.com/en-US/apps/648334/korn-ferry-assess/overview) ,[Korn Ferry Job Profile Manager](https://marketplace.workday.com/en-US/apps/509988/korn-ferry-job-profile-manager/overview) , and[Korn Ferry Single Job Pricing](https://marketplace.workday.com/en-US/apps/509988/korn-ferry-job-profile-manager/overview) Marketplace Apps bring Korn Ferry's IP, data and expertise into Workday, helping leaders turn workforce insight into business action.


Korn Ferry's Talent Suite applications and intelligence are now available directly within Workday through the Built on Workday program, bringing Korn Ferry’s knowledge, science, and proprietary data into the flow of work to help leaders have deeper insight.


Korn Ferry intelligence enriches Workday data so organizations can move beyond knowing what talent they have to understanding what they need, where gaps exist, and what to do next.


"The challenge for leaders isn't access to data, it's knowing what to do with it," said Mathias Herzog, President, Global Technology Practice, Korn Ferry and Leader of the firm’s Digital Solution. "Organizations need insight and shared standards that connect talent decisions to business performance. Korn Ferry Talent Suite provides that deeper intelligence, helping leaders make more informed decisions at scale."


Talent Suite is Korn Ferry’s intelligence engine, putting decades of knowledge, proven science and proprietary data to work for clients. It strengthens the advice Korn Ferry provides, powers the solutions it delivers and gives clients direct access to intelligence that helps them make better people decisions — from reshaping roles and building critical capabilities to improving productivity and preparing their workforce for AI and other rapidly changing business demands.


"Having workforce data isn't the hard part, knowing what to do with it is. That's the gap our partner ecosystem is built to close. With Korn Ferry, we’re bringing their talent expertise directly into Workday so customers can understand their people, close skills gaps and make smarter workforce decisions," said Mark Woollen, GVP Partner Innovation at Workday.


**About Korn Ferry**


Korn Ferry is a global consulting firm that powers performance. We unlock the potential in your people and unleash transformation across your business—synchronizing strategy, operations, and talent to accelerate performance, fuel growth, and inspire a legacy of change. That's why the world's most forward-thinking companies across every major industry turn to us—for a shared commitment to lasting impact and the bold ambition to Be More Than.


As the Official Talent & Organizational Consulting Partner of LA28, Korn Ferry is powering the nearly 5,000 people who power the Olympic Games—bringing in the right talent, building strong leaders, and shaping the structure and culture that will deliver an unforgettable experience for the world.
